values.note: Every main-campground site has water and electric; 138 of them also have sewer. The park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/myrtle-beach/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 140 sites'; 'Full Hookup Sites with Elec, Water, Sewer: 138 sites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 278 RV sites in the main campground (140 water/electric, 138 full hookup) plus a 30-site tent-only overflow campground open Easter weekend through Labor Day. Many sites take RVs up to 40 ft, others up to 30 ft. About 300 yards from the beach.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/myrtle-beach/camping ('Many sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 30 feet'; site counts), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/myrtle-beach/camping ('hot showers, restrooms and laundromat facilities'; Dump Station: Yes; Ranger Station store with groceries and camping supplies; 'All sites have complimentary wi-fi access'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum stay 14 nights (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park (843-238-5325). Check-in no earlier than 2 pm; no camper parking after noon check-out on Fri/Sat/Sun and holidays.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/myrtle-beach/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/myrtle-beach/campsites (policies: 'up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights'), read 2026-10-20; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water + sewer (amperage not stated, so electric left unset), 278 RV sites up to 40 ft, 14-night max stay, showers/laundry/dump/store/wifi. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Not stated: amps, season dates for the main campground, pull-throughs.
